_doc: War-bands (Dungeon Alive slice 5, C1; src/war_bands.py): groups that act like a unit, with roles from their lore. A band makes camp in one room of a floor (it replaces that room's ordinary roll), from 'floors' [first, last]. The top floors (1-6) hold only the small ones, sized for a new hero (2026-11-16: a level-1 hero of 30 HP is not swarmed; the bigger bands begin on floor 7): a goblin scouting party of a hobgoblin and at most two followers, a gang of footpads of a captain and one more ('most_followers' caps a band's followers in all, whatever each role rolled) (3.5.1: a floor's own encounters, set up when it is made, carry the fight; newcomers come only to a hero who lingers, src/wanderers.py). 'chance' is the share of floors in range that hold a band (at most one band a floor). Roles: 'leader' (one; while he lives his followers do not lose their nerve, and when one of the band spots the hero the whole band is roused), 'guard' (keep beside the leader), 'shooter' (keeps its distance), 'caster', 'healer' (mends the band). Each role lists kinds; only kinds the floor's own spawn pool allows are used, so a band is never out of its depth (LORE, NOT FLOOR). 'counts' [min, max] per role. 'morale' is what the band does when its leader falls: 'rout' (they flee), 'crumble' (the dead he raised fall where they stand), 'quarrel' (they turn on one another). 'camp' lists the fixtures of its camp. 'line' is said on arrival; 'known_line' instead when the hero knows the leader's family (studied, or its family tier): it names the band's make-up, {roster}. 'rout_line' is said when the leader falls, 'break_line' when a great blow on the leader breaks their nerve.

goblin_raiders.name: a goblin war-band
goblin_raiders._floors_note: From floor 7 since 2026-11-16 (it was 3): floors 1-6 hold only the small bands, sized for a new hero. On floor 3 this band put about 9.5 HP a turn on a hero of 30-40 HP.
goblin_raiders.line: Somewhere on this floor you hear drums and the tread of many feet.
goblin_raiders.rout_line: With their chief down, the goblins lose their nerve and scatter!
goblin_raiders.break_line: The goblins see their chief take that blow, and waver.

goblin_scouts.name: a goblin scouting party
goblin_scouts._counts_note: Smaller since 2026-11-16 (Brandon: floor-1 war-bands SHRINK; bug bash 3.5.1 Q12): a hobgoblin and at most two followers, goblins, perhaps a shaman (a sniper from floor 3). All on a level-1 hero (30 HP, AC 10): about 3 HP a turn on floor 1, at most 3.4 (it was 2-3 goblins and a shaman, about 4, up to 5).
goblin_scouts.line: Thin voices squabble over a cookfire, then a sharp bark hushes them.
goblin_scouts.rout_line: With the hobgoblin down, the scouts forget their orders and scatter!
goblin_scouts.break_line: The goblin scouts see their hobgoblin stagger, and start edging away.

gnoll_pack.name: a gnoll pack
gnoll_pack._floors_note: From floor 7 since 2026-11-16 (it was 6): floors 1-6 hold only the small bands.
gnoll_pack.line: Cackling laughter echoes off the stone: something hunts in a pack.
gnoll_pack.known_line: A gnoll pack on the hunt. {roster}.
gnoll_pack.rout_line: The pack lord falls, and the gnolls yelp and bolt!
gnoll_pack.break_line: The gnolls flinch as their pack lord staggers.

bandit_crew.name: a bandit crew
bandit_crew._floors_note: From floor 7 since 2026-11-16 (it was 3): floors 1-6 hold only the small bands. On floor 3 this crew put about 10 HP a turn on a hero of 30-40 HP.
bandit_crew.line: Woodsmoke, and laughter that stops when you stop walking.
bandit_crew.rout_line: Their captain down, the crew decide the pay is not worth it!
bandit_crew.break_line: The bandits glance at each other as their captain reels.

footpads.name: a gang of footpads
footpads._counts_note: Smaller since 2026-11-16 (Brandon: floor-1 war-bands SHRINK; bug bash 3.5.1 Q12): a couple of footpads, the captain and one more, a footpad or (one gang in four) an archer. All on a level-1 hero (30 HP, AC 10): about 3.4 HP a turn, at most 4 (it was 1-2 footpads and always the archer, about 6.5: dead in about 5 turns).
footpads.line: Somewhere ahead, a low whistle is answered by another.
footpads.rout_line: With their captain down, the footpads take to their heels!
footpads.break_line: The footpads see their captain reel, and their courage fails.

cult_circle.name: a cult circle
cult_circle.line: Far off you hear low chanting, the same five words over and over.
cult_circle.rout_line: Their priest falls, and the faithful lose all their faith and flee!
cult_circle.break_line: The chanting falters as their priest staggers.

necro_procession.name: a necromancer and his dead
necro_procession.line: Somewhere bones click together, like soldiers on the march.
necro_procession.rout_line: Their master falls, and the dead he raised fall with him!
necro_procession.break_line: The bound dead stagger as their master reels.

giant_hunt.name: a giant and his hounds
giant_hunt.line: You hear baying, and beneath it something huge that sniffs the air.
giant_hunt.rout_line: Their master falls, and the hounds care no longer to hunt you!
giant_hunt.break_line: The hounds whine as their master staggers.

fae_hunt.name: a hunt of the Fair Folk
fae_hunt._floors_note: From floor 18 since the monster pass of 2026-11-17 (it was 4): its leaders (the drow priestess, the Dullahan, the night hag) now live on floors 21-40, and Snorri's light elves in the rime halls, so the hunt rides the temple and, led by the hidden folk, the first of the rime.
fae_hunt.line: Far away a horn sounds, the loneliest sound you have ever heard.
fae_hunt.known_line: The Fair Folk ride a hunt. {roster}.
fae_hunt.rout_line: Their leader falls, and the Fair Folk melt back into the shadows!
fae_hunt.break_line: The hunt hesitates as its leader reels.

demon_warband.name: a warband of devils
demon_warband.line: Iron rings on iron, and a voice gives orders in an unknown tongue.
demon_warband.rout_line: Their captain falls, and the devils turn on one another!
demon_warband.break_line: The devils snarl at one another as their captain reels.

_observe: What Observe (O) says of a band member (2026-11-12). A follower: 'member'. The leader: 'leader', a thing anyone can see; a hero who knows the leader's kind (family_lore.knowledge KNOWN) hears 'leader_known' and what happens when it falls ('morale', by the band's morale). The arrival 'known_line', which names the band and its make-up (a short cue, 2026-11-22: how to break it is the leader's Observe line, never the arrival's), is likewise said only at KNOWN; 'line' never names the band's kind.

observe.leader: The rest of the band keep glancing at {him}, as if waiting for orders.

morale.rout: If {he} falls, the rest will lose their nerve.
morale.crumble: If {he} falls, the dead {he} raised will fall with {him}.
morale.quarrel: If {he} falls, the rest will turn on one another.

_role_names_one: A role with one member is named in the singular: 'one archer', never 'one archers' (war_bands.roster_text).

leader_falls._doc: When a 'rout' band's leader falls (or begs), each follower takes a morale test (src/morale.py: 2d10 over its kind's morale less `penalty` breaks it), and breaks its own way (a goblin runs for his friends and comes back with them, a beast bolts...; cornered or caught as it runs, it turns at bay). If `successor`, the band's biggest guard who passes his own test (no penalty) first takes up the lead: the band is his, and the rest test at `rallied_penalty`. The line said is 'rally' (someone took the lead), 'hold' (no one did, and not all broke) or the band's own 'rout_line' (every one broke). {The} is the new leader in 'rally', the fallen one in 'hold'. 'bands' holds a band's own numbers and lines, by its lore: goblins are bold only in a crowd, a cult's faithful are fanatics, hounds without their master's horn hunt no more.

lines.rally: {The} takes up the lead, and the band rallies!

lines.hold: The goblins shriek for {the} and fight on!
The goblins howl for {the} and fight on!

lines.rally: {The} howls, and the pack follows {him} now!
{The} takes up the chant, and the faithful hold!

great_blow._doc: A great blow on a band's living leader shakes the followers who see it (war_bands.on_great_blow): at least `chain` answers in the chain AND at least `share` of his health in the one blow (a blow that staggers him, not an ordinary one: the old rule was any chain of 6, most of a kid's chains). Each follower falters (frightened `turns` turns) `falter` of the time.
